name: Trident Freedivers
summary: A small freediving school run by Hanna Allen, a Barbadian national freediving record holder and PADI freediving instructor. Courses, fun dives and underwater photo sessions take place around the shipwrecks of Carlisle Bay, and guided spearfishing trips go out from the beach or offshore.
standouts: Run by Johanna Loch-Allen (Hanna), Barbadian freediving record holder in Free Immersion and Constant Weight
PADI Freediving instructor and Emergency First Response instructor
All instructors are Emergency First Response instructors
Rescue techniques taught on all freediving courses

trips.title: PADI certification course (2 days)
trips.summary: A two day PADI Freediver course covering static, dynamic and deep freediving, with breathing, equalisation and rescue skills. Day one starts with classroom work and moves into the water, and day two focuses on equalisation and depth. You finish with a PADI freediver card.
highlights: PADI certified freediver card on completion
Online learning materials for all 3 PADI freediver courses
Static, dynamic and deep freediving
Usually finishes with a fun dive on the Carlisle Bay shipwrecks
includes: Gear rental: long freediving fins, mask and snorkel
Rash guard tops available in a variety of sizes
Online learning materials for all 3 PADI freediver courses
trips.requirements: Minimum age 15. Must be a competent swimmer in good physical health. No prior experience required.
trips.checkNotes: Booked by a request form on the site (Book Now pop-up and contact page) or by phone and email; no online booking. The GoPro add-on is shown as $20 on this card and $20 USD on the one day card; footer says all prices are in US dollars.

trips.title: Freediving course (1 day)
trips.summary: A one day condensed version of the two day course, without the PADI certification. It covers static and deep freediving, equalisation, breathing and rescue, but not dynamic freediving.
highlights: Static and deep freediving
Equalisation, breathing techniques and rescue
Usually finishes with a fun dive on the Carlisle Bay shipwrecks

trips.title: Coastal Spearfishing Tour
trips.summary: A guided shore spearfishing trip for selective, sustainable fishing on the reefs. It starts with breath hold, equalisation and safety teaching and an introduction to spearguns and pole spears, then you swim out from the beach. Afterwards the guide shows you how to fillet the catch over tea and a snack on the beach.
highlights: Targets lobster, lionfish, barracuda, mackerel and snappers
Morning or afternoon tours
Pick up or meet at a set location
GoPro footage of the tour included
trips.departsFrom: Pick up from your accommodation or a designated meeting point

trips.checkNotes: Duration given as 3 to 4 hours on the card and about 4 hours in the text; morning tours 9am to 1pm, afternoon tours 1pm to 5pm. Booked by request form, phone or email.

trips.title: Blue water Tour
trips.summary: An offshore spearfishing trip for pelagic fish, for experienced spear fishers only. Spearfishing gear is available, though many guests bring their own.
highlights: Targets larger pelagic fish offshore
Runs year round
Rob Allen 130 guns with breakaway spear, float line and pressurised float available
GoPro footage included
trips.duration: 4 hours, with options for extra hours
trips.checkNotes: Price on enquiry. Booked by request form, phone or email.

trips.title: Spearfishing at night
trips.summary: A night spearfishing trip under the stars. The site gives few other details.
trips.checkNotes: Very little detail on the site. Booked by request form, phone or email.

trips.summary: An easy introduction to freediving with a photographer in the water. It includes Freediving 101 with Hanna, and you receive photos and videos of yourself freediving among the Carlisle Bay shipwrecks and marine life, delivered digitally.

checkNotes: No online booking: trips are requested through a form on the site (Book Now pop-up and contact page, asking for accommodation and fin size) or by phone and email.
